audit.quote_check: confirmed in the copy we hold
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote verified verbatim at the stated place (BSLP 70(1) p. 351, §1.2, last dash item) in the djvu text we hold, and duplicated in the held JSO 1975 Persée scanned (pp. 401-402). (2) The deciding source is a primary 1975 phonology article by the language's principal describer; Glottolog's entire descriptive bibliography for Nemi is three items by her, and a web search (LACITO author page, COCOON/Pangloss, Persée, Diachronica 2025 Lionnet on Paicî, general queries) turned up no later grammar, instrumental or prosodic study of Nemi. (3) Unheld items that could refine the record are the same author's 1979 sketch and 1982 comparative phonology (print/lending only) and J.-C. Rivierre 1993 (JSTOR, not loadable); none is open. J.-C. sources.quote: Describes initial accent (first mora, or first two morae in 4+ mora words) in Xârâcùù and tonal systems of Paicî/Cèmuhî/far south; the Hienghène/northern languages are cited only for aspirated-consonant correspondences. No statement about Nemi stress.
